# Object zones

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/zones.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The zone numbers that group a level's spawned objects, so a script can switch a whole area's objects
on or off with `ObjEnableZone(zone, enable)`. Zone 0 is on when a level starts and holds every object
spawned without a zone; zones 1 to 254 start off ([Tasks](../research/tasks.md#classes)). Numbers are
per level: the same number names different objects in different levels.

!!! info "What is complete"

    Every zone number a level's scripts name (`Zone<n>` globals, `<TABLE>.<NAME>_ZONE` fields), switch
    or spawn objects into: 225 zones in 62 levels. 66 of the 3,133 calls are left out because their zone is not a
    number the level defines: `global.lua`'s `BNESetup` switches its caller's `Zone21` to `Zone32`, and two calls
    of `level95` compute the zone. Objects the level file places in a zone are not counted (how it assigns them is
    not traced).

225 entries. Data: `research/references/zones.yaml`.

## Sources and evidence

Evidence levels used: inferred.

- the level scripts, ObjEnableZone and ObjSpawn

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | str | | `<level>:<zone>`. |
| `level` | str | | The level whose scripts use the zone. |
| `zone` | int | | Zone number (`ObjEnableZone`'s first argument, `ObjSpawn`'s fifth). |
| `names` | list | | The globals and table fields the level's scripts give the number. |
| `objects` | int | | How many `ObjSpawn` calls of the level put an object in the zone. |
| `enabled_by` | list | | Scripts that switch the zone on. |
| `disabled_by` | list | | Scripts that switch it off. |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
